newsitem.title: USA: United Cos Financial to buy private lender.
newsitem.headline: United Cos Financial to buy private lender.

text.p: United Cos Financial Corp said Tuesday it had signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire for $89 million Empire Funding Corp, a lender that specializes in home improvement loans in Texas.
The company said it would exchange about 2.6 million of its common shares for all of the outstanding common stock of Empire Funding.
The transaction, which is expected to close by late 1996, will likely be treated as a pooling of interests, it said.
If the transaction is accounted for as a purchase, the company said it would pay half the $89 million amount in cash, it added.
United Companies Financial Corp provides non-traditional consumer and mortgage loans throughout the United States.
